name.value: The Lens of the Outreaching Eye

description.value:
As long as you have the _Lens of the Outreaching Eye_ invested, the Harrowed Realm's impediments to magic don't apply to you, and you gain a +3 item bonus on all checks made to resolve divination effects.

- **Activate:** minute
- **Frequency:** once per day

By peering through the _Lens of the Outreaching Eye_, for one hour you can treat the Deck of Harrowed Tales as the source of your hearing and vision, no matter the deck's location in the multiverse. You can see in all directions from the deck and hear from it as if using your normal visual senses. You can Dismiss the activation.

- **Activate:** minute
- **Frequency:** once per day

The _Lens of the Outreaching Eye_ casts discern location on the Deck of Harrowed Tales.
